title: Ferulaceous
summary: FERULA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin ferula.] Pertaining to reeds or canes; having a stalk like a reed; or resembling the Ferula, as ferulaceous plants.

inlines.v: FERULA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin ferula.] Pertaining to reeds or canes; having a stalk like a reed; or resembling the Ferula, as ferulaceous plants.
